intent: A durable SQLite token store (~/data/token-dashboard/tokens.sqlite) that outlives Claude Code's transcript cleanup and feeds the control-panel /tokens cost dashboard, with 0 LLM tokens spent.
scope: python_pkg/token_dashboard/ (new): walk, rows, store, schema v3 with ordered additive migrations, finalize, carry, efficiency, ab, levers, context_files, aux, commits, survival, blocks, ingest; detail layer: classify, detail, detail_rows, detail_store, marks, hook_join (per-call, per-mark and per-turn rows with creation + carry cost); ab_rows (per-assignment A/B outcomes)
python_pkg/token_audit: persist structured lever candidates (Lever.metric join key) and expose the record primitives the walker shares
Non-goal: the remaining dashboard panel groups A-Q (tracked in ~/src/control-panel/TODO-token-dashboard-panels.md)
changes: Resumable incremental ingest: walks changed transcripts until its --budget is spent, commits, exits pending if any remain
Schema migrations never drop the store; rows of vanished transcripts are kept
token_audit --recommend stores the lever candidates as data in the snapshot (snap['levers'])

New raw tables calls / marks / turn_detail (no schema version bump: CREATE IF NOT EXISTS) with key, cwd, model, ts, day, is_sub so the dashboard's filter clause applies; carry.Tracker settles creation (next call's cache-write multiplier x input price) and carry_calls too
ab.rebuild also stores per-assignment rows in ab_rows so the A/B panel can recount arms per cwd/model/scope

verification.evidence: token_dashboard: parsed 7 files, refreshed 2 sessions in 0.7s; exit 0

verification.command: sqlite3 tokens.sqlite 'DELETE FROM files' && python3 -m python_pkg.token_dashboard.ingest --budget 40
verification.evidence: full re-walk of 1616 transcripts in one 32.5 s pass; 114,599 calls, 103,713 turn_detail rows; store kept (backup tokens.v3-2026-10-18.sqlite)

risks: A schema change without a MIGRATIONS entry would leave old stores without the new column
Transcript format drift in Claude Code could make the walker skip new record types
rollback: git revert this commit; the store file is left untouched and stays readable by the previous code
Validate: control-panel /api/tokens/overview still answers from the existing store
